_doc: Single source of truth for generated audio. ids are the game's real event/track ids (tests/audio-catalog.test.ts enforces coverage). Edit a prompt and the generator re-spends credits for that entry only (hash in audio-lock.json).
sfxStyle: Isolated single game sound effect, clean dry studio recording, no music, no speech, no background ambience, no reverb tail beyond what is described.
sfxVariants: Variation: slightly different timbre and a touch higher pitched.
Variation: slightly lower pitched with a different tail.
musicStyle: Instrumental only, no vocals, no spoken words. Constant tempo in 4/4 with no tempo changes or rubato. Starts immediately at full groove with no intro, no fade-in, no fade-out, no ending, designed to loop seamlessly. Clear separate layers: sustained pads and bass bed, distinct drums and percussion, and a separate melodic lead. Cinematic, polished video-game soundtrack mix.

music.prompt: Moody atmospheric sci-fi title theme at exactly 84 BPM in A minor. Slow evolving analog pads, deep sub bass, a sparse glassy arpeggio, a distant heroic synth lead, soft drums. Hopeful yet ominous, the calm before a rift opens.

Organic overgrown crystal wilderness at exactly 96 BPM in D dorian. Warm kalimba and marimba plucks, glassy crystalline arpeggios, wooden and shaker percussion with a soft kick, warm sub bass, lush green pads, curious and adventurous with an undercurrent of danger.

Dead industrial forge that still burns at exactly 112 BPM in A phrygian. Heavy metallic anvil and chain percussion, pounding kick, distorted analog bass, rhythmic machinery clangs, brass-like synth stabs, smouldering ember pads. Relentless and oppressive.

Flooded library of frozen knowledge at exactly 104 BPM in C major with a lydian colour. Ethereal reverbed felt piano, glassy harmonics, bubbling arpeggios, deep slow pads, cold shimmering synths, restrained steady drums. Mysterious, melancholy, submerged.

Cosmic void where the rift bleeds through at exactly 120 BPM in G with a flat second. Dissonant sweeping pads, glitchy granular textures, pulsing driving sequenced bass, wide ethereal arpeggios, tense cinematic drums. Alien, vast and tense.

Generic epic boss battle at exactly 124 BPM in E minor. Hybrid orchestral and electronic, driving taiko-style drums, pulsing bass, urgent staccato strings, heroic brass-synth lead. Intense and climactic.
Fungal hive-mind overlord boss at exactly 100 BPM in D minor. Pulsing organic bass, throbbing spore-like percussion, wet low brass drones, swarming staccato strings, creeping dread that escalates.

Storm conductor boss at exactly 132 BPM in D minor. Thunderous driving orchestral percussion, urgent rapid string ostinato, crackling electric arcs, soaring conducting-baton energy, relentless and stormy.

Giant mechanical spider siege engine boss at exactly 118 BPM in A phrygian. Heavy industrial machine groove, metal clanging percussion, pounding distorted bass, siren-like synth risers, menacing and mechanical.
Molten giant boss at exactly 108 BPM in A phrygian. Slow heavy pounding war drums, huge detuned brass-like synth, fiery roaring textures, doom-laden and crushing.
Enormous sea beast boss at exactly 90 BPM in C minor. Deep ocean sub drones, whale-like tonal moans, slow crushing percussion, swelling cinematic strings, vast and terrifying.

Radiant angelic seraph guardian boss at exactly 128 BPM in C lydian. Shimmering crystalline synth choirs without vocals, soaring heavenly lead, fast bright arpeggios, driving dance-like drums, beautiful but menacing.
Hollow spectral king boss at exactly 110 BPM in G minor. Gothic organ-like synths, funereal cello, tolling bells, tense mid-tempo marching drums, regal and haunted.

Final boss, cosmic ruler of the rift, at exactly 140 BPM in G minor with a flat second. Massive cinematic hybrid orchestra and synths, frantic driving percussion, dissonant risers, apocalyptic and triumphant.
